Return compounds reported in the specified document. For each compound, provide the ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. List the results ordered by the ChEMBL ID. Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_records, compound_structures. Join: docs to compound_records on doc_id; compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1122107'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
